item.title: Why Seedance 2.5 and Hailuo H3 Ignore Prompts and How to Fix It with a 3D Scene
item.description:
Hi Habr! I'm Ilya Trikhoz, co-founder and developer at GPTunneL. Today, I'll tell you about something we created when we got tired of watching expensive video models repeatedly invent their own direction instead of what we asked for. But now, you can assemble a video differently: 1) generate a 3D scene from primitives, set up cameras; 2) get a render reference, which Seedance 2.5 or Hailuo H3 will follow precisely. Angles, timing, cuts – everything is predictable, stays on the canvas, and any step can be redone. Instead of persuading the model with text, we show it directly (with cubes, so to speak). So, meet the "3D Scene" node in our workflow constructor. Read more

item.title: One AI codes, the second commands: how Devin Fusion works
item.description:
On September 11, Cognition announced the availability of Fusion in Devin Desktop and CLI. Previously, the system worked in the cloud-based Devin. Now, the combination of a leading model and an executor can be used in the desktop application and terminal. The company recommends the Claude Fable 5.1 and SWE-2 combination. Recall that Devin is a tool where you can assign it tasks related to studying a project, changing code, and checks. Fusion, in turn, organizes the joint work of two models. One, for example, creates a plan and accepts the result, the other is responsible for implementation. It's like a regular development team, but without dailies. Read more

item.title: How I Automated Almost All Work in My CRM
item.description:

item.title: The Agentic Future
item.description:
Imagine a typical day a few years from now. You've almost stopped using the internet directly. Your personal AI agent uses it for you. You don't go to online stores, open messengers, search for doctors, or correspond with insurance companies. Services haven't disappeared – they've simply become infrastructure for your agent to interact with. The agent has ordered groceries for dinner; gathered and provided documents for a dispute with insurance; rearranged your calendar so you can pick up your child; booked you a doctor's appointment during a convenient slot. You were barely involved. Your calendar has updates, some tasks have vanished, and the agent only asked for confirmation on one important action. Your smartphone has become just one way to communicate with your personal agent. The same agent is accessible on your laptop, in your car, on your watch, and in your headphones. Applications haven't disappeared. A constant intermediary, who knows your context and acts on your behalf, has simply emerged between you and the digital world. Read more

item.title: I Made the Head of the AI Office Swear at Agents. And Only Then Did I Understand What Actually Worked
item.description:
At some point, I made the head of my AI office swear at his subordinates. Not for a laugh. It's just that before that, my agents could produce mediocre results very politely, very diligently, and sometimes very expensively. After such a boss appeared, the office's behavior changed noticeably. And my first thought was quite simple: well, it's clear, neural networks just need a tougher boss. As it turned out, it's not clear at all. Read more
